# Starship Titanic - Archipelago Mod
A Starship Titanic client for use with [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg/). Stability has come a long way, but this should still be used in live games with caution.

**For use with the Steam release of Starship Titanic only** 

Requires [.NET 8.0 Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/en-us/download/dotnet/8.0)

## Installation
*This guide assumes you already have Archipelago installed on your computer*
1. Download and install the [.NET 8.0 Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/en-us/download/dotnet/8.0) if you do not already have it
2. Download the .apworld and client files from the Releases page. Run the .apworld file to add it to your Archipelago custom worlds
3. Extract the client anywhere on your PC
4. In the Archipelago launcher, run the "Generate Template Options" tool to generate a template .yaml file in your Player/Templates folder
5. Edit a copy of the template .yaml with your preferred editor
6. Provide the .yaml file to the host of the room, or visit [archipelago.gg](https://archipelago.gg/tutorial/) for details on generating your own multiworld
7. Start the game and the client. Click Attach in the client if needed (the client will auto-attach if started after the game), then click Connect to AP... and fill out the server info. 
8. Click connect and play

## Playing the AP
### Receiving items
- By default (Item Delivery Method: Succubus), when you are sent an item from the multiworld, **it does not immediately end up in your inventory.** You need to go to any Succ-U-Bus and press the Receive button in your PET's Control tab (middle icon). The Succ-U-Bus will dispense your item into the tray. Don't forget to pick it up!
   - If you have multiple items queued for delivery, simply press Receive again. Don't forget to take your item out of the tray after each arrives
   - With Item Delivery Method set to Direct To Inventory, received items go straight into your inventory instead
### Hints
- Click just about anything in the client window to request a hint for it. Hovering shows any hints it already has. Checks with known hint are color coded
### Timesavers
- **Skip Intro**: setting this option to true will automatically skip the intro sequence and credits and put you in the Embarkation Lobby when you select Start a New Game in the main menu
   - Note that this places you before the initial check-in conversation with the Deskbot, so that should be your first step
- **Quick Elevator**: Drastically shortens elevator ride animations
- **Quick Pellerator**: Same as Quick Elevator but for the Pellerator
- **Quick Barbot Freakout**: Drastically shortens the animation and control lockout after completing the Titanic Titillator cocktail
### Client commands
Usable in-game or in the client window:
  - **/help** - list all client commands
  - **/ap \<text\>** - sends \<text\> to the AP server from in game. Can be used to send server chat messages (/ap hi cuties!) or AP commands (/ap !players)
  - **/hint** - alias for /ap !hint. Used the same way as AP's !hint command
  - **/force_seed** - forces the client to accept the current save as the correct save for the connected slot
  - **/return \<item\>** - [experimental] Returns an item to your inventory. Only works with items already received from the multiworld. Recommended only as a bug recovery tool
  - **/getmail** - (Succ-U-Bus item delivery mode only) moves all the pending granted AP items from the mail system straight into your inventory
  - **/loc** - prints your current location data
  - **/clues** - shows the Parrot Hunt clues revealed so far
### Parrot Hunt goal: 
Oh no! The parrot has gotten himself stuck in a random 2nd or 1st Class Stateroom's Succ-U-Bus! Find Progressive Clues in the multiworld. Some of them reveal the stateroom's elevator, floor or room number. Once you know all three (or before, if you have a guess!), go to that stateroom's Succ-U-Bus terminal and save the parrot from its clutches!
 
## FAQ
- Why only the Steam version of the game? What about GOG? Can I use my original discs?
  - Simply put, the Steam version is the one that I own. I plan to eventually pick up the GOG version and test it, because there's a good chance it's the same ScummVM version of the game and might work out of the box. The original discs will never be supported. This implementation depends on the rebuilt engine used in the ScummVM release
- I was granted an item, but it's not in my inventory
  - By default, the Item Delivery Method option is set to Succ-U-Bus (default), granted items are placed into the Succ-U-Bus mail delivery system. There is a Succ-U-Bus terminal in just about every room in the ship. Approach one and use the Receive button in the UI to receive an item. Repeat for any additional items
- The Deskbot said she upgraded my class and/or assigned me a stateroom, but nothing happened
  - The default behavior for class upgrades and stateroom assignment is via Multiworld items. Completing the processes to get class upgrades from the Deskbot are still location checks, though
- What do I do next?
  - Despite the randomization, all of the puzzles in the game work the same as they do in a vanilla game. Walkthroughs are really useful for this game, especially if you've never played it

## Locations and Items
[Locations](https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP/wiki/Locations) in this apworld include:
- Picking up inventory items
- Solving puzzles
- Visiting rooms for the first time
- Visiting every Succ-U-Bus terminal on the ship

[Items](https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP/wiki/Items) include:
- Most carryable inventory items
- Progressive Class Upgrades (Optional, default on)
- Progressive Staterooms (Optional, default on)
- Access Cards for all ship areas that must be acquired from the multiworld (Optional, default off)
- Parrot Hunt Clues (Parrot Hunt goal only)

## Generative AI Use Disclosure
- Claude Code was used moderately in the development of this AP integration, especially for reverse engineering, finding memory offsets, and building hooks to manipulate game logic
- The majority of the apworld code was written by hand
- All generated code was reviewed, edited, and tested by hand
- The design and features of this integration were made without creative input from AI

notes.text:
Major updates to both client and .apworld. Incompatible with older seeds.
Make sure to regenerate your YAML templates to see the new options.
## New Features
- Full client UI redesign
- In-client Logic tracking: See in-logic checks. Hover over locked checks to see what they require
- In-client hints: Click just about anything in the client to request a hint for it
- New Goal: Parrot Hunt! Receive clues from the multiworld to discover which stateroom the parrot is trapped in
- New YAML options (see YAML for detailed descriptions):
  - Passenger Class Upgrades: Multiworld (default) or Vanilla
  - Stateroom Assignments: Multiworld (default) or Vanilla
  - AP Item Delivery Method: Succ-u-Bus (default) or Direct to Inventory
  - More Room Access Card generation options: Enabled, Randomized, Selection, Disabled (default)
  - Easy Music Room Puzzle: (default false) When true, pre-sets the music room panel controls to the solution
  - Skip Intro: Skips past the intro and opening credits
  - Quick Elevator/Quick Pellerator: Drastically shortens ride animations
  - Quick Barbot Freakout: Drastically shortens animation and control lockout after completing the Titanic Titillator
- New Checks: Puree the Starlings, Defeat the Maitre'D, Music Room puzzle, SGT Stateroom Furniture puzzle, Arboretum Seasons
- Added YAML-less UT Support
## Changes
- Traps have been removed temporarily. I've never gotten around to implementing them, so they've never actually done anything
- Added full [Location](https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP/blob/main/docs/Location.md) and [Item](https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP/blob/main/docs/Items.md) lists to the repo for reference
## Fixes
- Tons of cosmetic fixes affecting most items
- Pistachio bowl puzzle required an assigned 2nd class stateroom in logic, but can be completed in any 2nd class stateroom
- Checks could briefly be sent from incorrect save files before the guard stops them
- Nose could be stuck in inventory in rare circumstances
- Mouth could be permanently hidden in very rare circumstances
- Being granted an item while standing at its natural pickup location causes issues
- Turning in the Magazine before the check-in conversation would eat it with no results
- Swapping the music in the restaurant would make fighting the Maitre'D impossible
- Repairing Titania would block access to the rest of the ship, blocking progress in goals that don't end there
- Installed fuses and Titania parts would be removed and returned to inventory when their checks are sent
- Incorrect random room calculation sometimes assigned a Parrot Hunt room that didn't exist
- Fixed a few minor logic issues
- Fixed several crash causes
## Known Issues in this release
- None

Find installation instructions at [https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP#installation](https://github.com/rescheer/Starship-Titanic-AP#installation)
